shortDescription: Brazilian lender Itau Unibanco BMFBOVESPA:ITUB3 reported on Tuesday a third-quarter net recurring profit of 12.62 billion reais  ($2.30 billion), up 6.2% from a year earlier and compared to 12.63 billion reais in an LSEG poll with analysts.($1 = 5.4965 reais)
